text: I have cities but no houses, forests but no trees, and rivers but no water. What am I?
The more of me you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
I have hands but cannot clap, and a face but cannot smile. What am I?
I have keys but open no locks, and space but no room. You can enter, but you cannot go in. What am I?
I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with sound. What am I?
What can you catch, but never throw?
I am lighter than a feather, yet the strongest person cannot hold me for long. What am I?
The more of me there is, the less you can see. What am I?
What goes up when the rain comes down?
I have a neck but no head, and I wear a cap. What am I?
I have one eye but cannot see, and I pull a thread wherever I go. What am I?
I have branches but no fruit, no trunk and no leaves. What am I?
The more I dry, the wetter I become. What am I?
What can fill a whole room but takes up no space at all?
I am always hungry and must be fed. The finger I touch will soon turn red. What am I?
I have many teeth, but I never bite. What am I?
What begins with T, ends with T, and is full of T?
I run but never walk, I have a mouth but never talk, and I have a bed but never sleep. What am I?
A box without hinges, key or lid, yet golden treasure inside is hid. What am I?
What belongs to you, but is used far more by everyone else?
What building has the most stories?
I have a thumb and four fingers, but I am not alive. What am I?
I fly without wings and cry without eyes. Wherever I go, darkness follows. What am I?
I am full of holes, yet I can still hold water. What am I?
I follow you all day long, but vanish in the dark. What am I?
I am so fragile that saying my name will break me. What am I?
I can travel all around the world while staying stuck in a corner. What am I?
I am taken from the ground and shut in a wooden case, and I am never let out, yet nearly everyone uses me. What am I?
I have a spine but no bones, and I have pages but no wings. I have many words, but I never speak. What am I?
I go through towns and over hills, yet I never move. What am I?
I am tall when I am young and short when I am old. What am I?
I am given but never taken, kept but never held, and broken but never dropped. What am I?
The more of me you give away, the more of me there is. What am I?
I am always coming, but I never arrive. What am I?
I fly without wings and pass without a sound. No one can catch me or keep me. What am I?
What kind of room has no doors and no windows?
I have a ring but no finger, and you speak into me. What am I?
What goes up every year but never comes down?
I go up and down, yet I never move a step. What am I?
I show you a face that is yours, but I speak not a single word. What am I?
I am round, I have no end, and two people who love each other share me. What am I?
I fall but never get hurt, I come in winter and melt in the sun. What am I?
I have four legs but never walk, and you rest your head on me each night. What am I?
I can shake the trees and sing through the keyhole, yet no one has ever seen me. What am I?
I rise in the oven and am broken at the table. Everyone shares me. What am I?
